title: God of War Sons of Sparta comes to PS4 on 16 Nov with two free new modes (Hermes, Erebus) on PS4 and PS5
headline: God of War Sons of Sparta: PS4 From 16 Nov
caption:
God of War Sons of Sparta, the 2D action-platformer from Santa Monica Studio and Mega Cat Studios, comes to PS4 on Monday, 16 November. It has been a PS5 game since 12 February 2026. It tells the story of a young Kratos and his brother Deimos during their Spartan training.

The same day, a free patch adds two new modes on both PS4 and PS5. Hermes Mode is for speedrunners, with a split timer and a scoreboard. It unlocks after you finish the game once, or with this code on the start menu: Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right, L1, R1, Touchpad. In Erebus Mode, you and every enemy go down in a single hit. You pick the mode when you start a save, and you can't change it later.

On the PS Store in India, the PS5 version costs ₹2,497 and the Digital Deluxe Edition ₹3,330. The PS4 price isn't listed yet.

Is your PS4 still the console you play on most?

Sources: PlayStation Blog, Gematsu, PS Store India
